mechanism.takes: a folder of agent configuration files (markdown with YAML frontmatter, JSON settings) on the local machine, plus every project folder the agent tool has been used in
mechanism.does: indexes them by kind and scope, renders them in an editor-side panel with a form for the frontmatter and a text editor for the body, and writes edits back preserving untouched formatting and line endings
mechanism.returns: the same files edited in place, created, renamed, duplicated or moved to the trash

portsAsIs: frontmatter form editor that keeps unchanged keys byte-identical
editor-panel layout with searchable sidebar and per-scope sections
isolated-instance verification over the debugging protocol

mechanism.takes: the agent tool's local configuration (per-user and per-project files) plus the tool's own command-line inventory of connected tool servers
mechanism.does: shows each project's setup on its own page, lets the user add a project folder or a parent folder of projects, picks allowed tools from a checklist in a panel and inline in the text editor, lists every tool server with its source, status and live tool list, and switches servers on or off per project or everywhere by editing the per-project disable lists
mechanism.returns: the configuration files edited in place, with every untouched key byte-identical

portsAsIs: tool-server inventory merged from config files and the CLI's health-checked list
live server description and tool list over the standard handshake for reachable servers
per-project and everywhere on/off switches written surgically into a shared JSON config
checklist picker for allowed-tool lists that keeps the list's YAML shape

mechanism.takes: a VS Code extension repository and a Marketplace publisher the owner controls
mechanism.does: federates an Azure DevOps service connection to a managed identity that holds only read access in Azure and contributor rights on the publisher, then runs a manual pipeline that packages the extension and publishes it only when a parameter is switched on
mechanism.returns: a packaged extension per run and, on request, a Marketplace release, with no long-lived token anywhere
